name: ULR Contract Examples
summary: Optional independent consumers of the Ultimate Light Rail station API.
description: Independent API v1 examples for Ultimate Light Rail 1.0.0 (revision 49). Adds a fixed 80m surface station using asset roles and a configurable component-kit station with 20m platform/roof models, through/terminus types, all supported lengths and Covered/Minimal appearances. Both use the shared Light Rail menu helper. This optional mod depends on Ultimate Light Rail; it is not required by the core.
